searchText: Are there any resources on alternative visions on logs from early on: Why was logging everything seen as unfriendly to lightclients? https://eth.wiki/en/fundamentals/design-rationale A whole 5 opcodes feels like a lot from the perspective of 2021: was the tradeoff that fewer would require larger bytecode and be less convenient for devs (e.g. if logs only held one topic and there were multiple of these emitted for a single event).
